title: Thermablok Aerogel Insulation
content:
Thermablok is a well-known supplier of aerogel-based insulation solutions for the building sector. The company commercializes thin-profile aerogel insulation products designed to reduce thermal bridging in residential, commercial, and retrofit construction projects.

  • Coverage Area: North America, the United Kingdom, and selected international markets
  • Focus Areas: Thermal-bridge mitigation, building-envelope upgrades, retrofit insulation, window and door interfaces, and thin-profile construction insulation
  • Current Brands Represented: Thermablok® aerogel insulation products
  • Official Website: https://www.thermablok.com
review_notes: Directory profile reviewed for listing quality, category fit, and current public website availability.
